scientific_choices.ASSUMPTION: Fit the same finite image-count head families and word-risk features with five RGB-grouped FIT crossfolds. Select combined heldout-FIT and validation microF1 at separately scaled quotas, retaining an explicit validation floor; compare qualified fallback/complement variants with same cost-aware tie rule. No TEST labels or outputs enter fitting or selection. Sources and labels are conditionally stacked: source detectors and other word folds can have seen an outer-fold image; these scores are not fully nested unbiased CV.
scientific_choices.HARDWARE_DEVIATION: CPU float64 crossfit and cached predictions; no new GPU/DeepSolo inference.
scientific_choices.PAPER_SPECIFIED: Broad fallback motivation only; supervised count utility is an approximate extension.
scientific_choices.REPOSITORY_SPECIFIED: Original real prediction caches, expert-image-excluded FIT outputs when available, native256 ignore/care, trained word risk, already qualified per-dataset fallback variants and available real map features.
scientific_choices.UNRESOLVED: Prior/repeated TEST exploration, benchmark TRAIN-vocabulary validation exposure, conditional stacking, small validation and final generalization.
